title: Hay Fuel
description: A hay block has always been useless as fuel despite being flammable. This mod fixes that — it lets you burn hay blocks in furnaces, and adds a compressed version that acts as a proper coal alternative, giving players a renewable, farm-based fuel source.
body:
A hay block has always been useless as fuel despite being flammable. This mod fixes that — it lets you burn hay blocks in furnaces, and adds a compressed version that acts as a proper coal alternative, giving players a renewable, farm-based fuel source.

![Hay — a new way to keep your furnace running.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30a45bd15991fbcdba5ce661c7f89c5dea6dd125.png)
